# Pinned install of Agent Reach for Mark's read-only pilot (D182). Not used by any image or script:
# Mark installs it once, into /workspace/ar, after the person approves the card.
#
# Pinned: Agent Reach 1.6.1, commit 8d9ecc1f5521fe7d223cde782aaa4005695e2671 (the commit archive below,
# sha256 taken from two identical downloads on 27 Nov 2026). Dependencies: the versions of that commit's
# constraints.txt (requests, loguru, PyYAML, yt-dlp, yt-dlp-ejs) plus what they pull in, and the build
# backend hatchling with its own dependencies, so that nothing is built from an unpinned download.
# Each package lists every file hash PyPI publishes for that version, so any platform's file is accepted
# and nothing else is.
#
# Commands (three steps; --no-build-isolation needs hatchling already installed, so step A comes first):
#   python3 -m venv /workspace/ar
#   /workspace/ar/bin/pip install --require-hashes -r build-requirements.txt
#   /workspace/ar/bin/pip install --require-hashes --no-build-isolation -r requirements.txt
# Checked on 27 Nov 2026 in a scratch venv: the dependency lines below install with --require-hashes,
# and `agent-reach --help` runs when the package is installed from the local clone with --no-deps.
# End to end, archive line included, on 27 Nov 2026 in the real freeduet-agent-computer image (Python 3.12.3):
# step A and step B both exit 0, pip check is clean, agent-reach --help, web read and youtube search run.
# Upgrades are refused: to change a version, regenerate this file from the new constraints.txt.
